findings.title: No test pins the line total's quantity factor
findings.detail: The new tests pin the rounding, but dropping * it.Qty still leaves go test ./cart/... green: every item in the tests has a quantity of one.
findings.risk_rationale: An order of several units of one item would be priced as one unit with the suite still green.

summary: The rounding is pinned now; the quantity factor still survives its mutant.

probes.seam: Pricing a multi-item order with a discount returns the once-applied, rounded total
